notes.title: Major Patch Fix
notes.content:
12/20/2019

After a long hiatus I have fixed many, many new bugs and made countless tweaks to the game. Unfortunately, I did not maintain a record of all these but it was probably 300-400 items.  Most of them were small but a few were big.  Here are some big items:

* It's now much easier to gain levels with hats at higher levels, so now you can see what vantage you unlock at level 10
* When  the enemy Garbajosa uses Warning Shot it could make the cursor unavailable until the game is entirely rebooted. This is addressed.
* Whenever damage is received, you can see the portion of damage that is drained highlighted in a different color and then shrink away. Also, enemy animations are timed better with attack animations and damage numbers.
* Hats from BHH can be purchased earlier
* Moon's Diadem hat is in a different place.  It was given by Mistress Ivy but I couldn't even remember and figure this out. So it's in an easier place to find now at an earlier point.
* An error in the fight with Scorpion Saint was fixed that could have made the battle unwinnable.
* A sound glitch was fixed that was hopefully the cause of some crashes
* Many vantages have been tweaked or even changed somewhat. If you found a vantage useless in the past, try it again and see if it's better.
* Some vantages that were not working quite like intended that are now fixed or changed include: Guns Blazing, Confession
* Status ailments now fade out as they wear off
* You can walk behind more things, like church pews and gravestones

notes.content:
More, mostly minor, bugs addressed. The biggest change is that the Sally fight will save your progress after fighting the first form. See all changes here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/727290/discussions/0/1499000547484363194/

notes.title: Patch Log April 22, 2018
notes.content:
Many more minor bugs addressed and some vantages reconfigured and beefed up such as Rosy's Pith helmet Vantages. Taming and feeding animals should be much more useful. If you believe a particular vantage is not effective enough, let me know and I'll consider balancing.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/727290/discussions/0/1499000547484363194/

notes.content:
Patch Changes 1/6/2017

* Fixed placement of campfire in circus
* Softened some sounds
* Fixed icons on health sign
* Fixed dialogue for circus person
* Fixed Sacrifice so you actually die
* Changed lunch break so it would not continue to add to your vantages.
* Fixed Dime Novel to give you 2x VP
* Changed crop and animal reset time to 2 hours, store inventory reset set to 48 hours

All noted bugs have been addressed
